hint: Hover or tap a command group.

parts.title: robin runs
parts.body: Everything about runs: submit a list of recordings, follow its progress down to each recording and task, and cancel, withdraw or retry it. Each command is safe to repeat.

parts.title: robin models
parts.body: Register a model card and its files, and look up what is registered.

parts.title: robin presets
parts.body: Give a configuration (a model plus settings) a fixed name people can reuse.

parts.title: robin reconcile
parts.body: One pass of the controller loop: stop cancelled work, record ended tasks, prepare waiting runs, launch queued tasks. With --loop it repeats until stopped.

parts.title: robin db migrate
parts.body: Create or update the run manager's tables.

parts.title: robin whoami
parts.body: Show the database login your commands will use.

parts.title: Global options
parts.body: --profile picks the deployment and --env its environment (there is no default, so you never hit production by accident). --json prints one JSON object for scripts.

parts.title: Every list command
parts.body: Pages with --limit and --cursor, or --all for everything.

parts.title: No API in between
parts.body: CLI commands call the run manager directly, with your own database login.
